statement: Find a source-specific genuinely total codimension-p witness/incidence/correspondence representation, not factoring through fixed selected component charts, whose projection is proved first-order surjective onto the exact local Hodge-locus branch for the total rational class, with explicit signed-rational coefficient/category and rational-equivalence semantics.
why_now: The solved conic control proves that changing-decomposition total representations can have tangent directions absent from fixed-component factorization, so the fixed-component no-go cannot close this representation family. What remains is to realize the escape in a nontrivial higher-codimension Hodge setting rather than in automatic divisor geometry.
precommitted_falsifiers: the candidate total object factors through the fixed-component fibre product after all, so H4d1c-b non-expansion applies
its tangent image reaches ambient base directions but not the frozen Hodge-locus tangent
the claimed total class loses signed rational coefficient/category semantics or replaces rational equivalence by an inequivalent moduli relation
surjectivity is assumed in a hypothesis or hidden inside a complete obstruction-vanishing reformulation
a special-family dimension identity is transferred without an explicit applicability/DifferenceWitness
priority_source_families: flag-Hilbert/incidence constructions for complete-intersection cycles on hypersurfaces
correspondence-induced total cycles with source-bound tangent control
normal-function/Abel-Jacobi constructions only when they output actual witness reachability rather than detector vanishing
degeneration/specialization only after a separately frozen singular and monodromy interface
